verdictStatement: The v5 SHOULD-FIX is repaired. /authorityClaim is explicitly on the v6 closed roster and no longer names a generation as this artifact's predecessor; /basedOn alone carries the predecessor path and its measured v5 digest. A full recursive semantic diff found 16 changed leaf paths and all 16 are covered by the declared roster. /truthTables is structurally identical to v5, so no ENFORCED cell moved; an independent census still reproduces 28 cells as 24 DISCLOSURE-ONLY, 2 ENFORCED-BY-CONSTRUCTION, and 2 ENFORCED-AT-HOST-BROKER. One non-gating advisory records that COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md advanced by additive D-105 after v6 froze, stranding the word 'Live' on the otherwise accurate D-104 snapshot.
